provenance.net_alignment_status: unachievable by construction: the engine has no emigration law, so an entry-only schedule is aligned to gross inflow and its distance from the published net path is reported as entry_only_minus_net_gap
provenance.network_access: none; reads only the committed, hash-verified snapshot
provenance.universe_bridge_status: unbridged: V.A2 counts the Social Security area, the certified frame counts the Census resident population; any schedule aligned to this control is an ssa_area_proxy

not_supported_by_this_artifact: entrant benefit levels (AIME, PIA, claiming) - suppressed
insured status and prior US covered earnings - censored, not zero
population stocks, dependency ratios and net migration - an entry-only schedule cannot close a net path
any post-entry transition of an entrant
annual arrival resolution - the donor band is 2022-2024

frame_diagnostics.calibration_status: UNCALIBRATED: no nativity column appears in deployment_frame.REQUIRED_SOURCE_COLUMNS and the certified file pins no nativity margin, so this composition is a free consequence of the reweighting, not a target it hit

provenance.annual_resolution_disclosure: CPS year-of-entry is binned, so this donor cannot produce an annual arrival cohort directly; band_midpoint_rounded_up is the stated rule applied, and it is not gradeable against CPS itself. ACS PUMS YOEP would buy annual resolution and is the named successor artifact
provenance.stock_proxy_disclosure: stock_proxy: the survey observes a resident survivor/stayer at interview, not an arrival. Education, marriage, disability, employment, earnings and residence all change between reported entry and interview; only age and sex are carried, and only because the donor is restricted to the most recent arrival band (lag 0-2 years)
provenance.universe_reason: PEINUSYR's universe is everyone not born in the fifty states, so the recent-arrival band also holds natives born in PR/outlying areas (PRCITSHP 2) and abroad of US parents (PRCITSHP 3). They are US citizens at birth and appear in neither of Table V.A2's stocks -- internal migration, not immigration -- so they are excluded to match the control's universe

vintage_domain_mismatch.interpretation: each listed (source_year, peinusyr) pair carries a code the labelled ASEC vintage's published data dictionary does not define; no arrival year is asserted for those rows

claiming_eligibility.counterfactual: without this exclusion apply_claiming would draw a claim age for 1350 entrant rows aged 50+, each of whom carries a pinned zero earnings history
claiming_eligibility.reason: steps.py:390-450 draws a claim age for everyone aged 50+ with no insured-status, quarters-of-coverage, AIME or PIA test; reported year of entry does not identify FIRST entry, so prior US covered earnings are unknown/censored rather than zero and insured status cannot be established from either survey

disability_panel.reason: disability.py:56-60 filters a PSID-built DisabilityPanel to holdout_ids; entrants are not in the panel, and ASEC/CPS disability items are not realized PSID M4 status

earnings_domain.reason: earnings_domain.py:150-208 keys membership on the generator's fitted 2014 state and forward_earnings.py:1421-1436 raises without it; the section 2.8.3a certificate was never fitted on entrants and does not transfer to them

fertility_risk.reason: steps.py:451-506 materializes births only for on-roster mothers and initializes parity at zero; no entrant parity or birth-history seed exists, so leaving entrants at risk would assert every entrant arrived childless

exclusions.interpretation: an excluded entrant is OUTSIDE the estimand for that domain, not a person modelled as having no children, no disability and no claim; suppressed counts are reported instead of zeros for exactly that reason
exclusions.not_certified: entrant benefit levels, insured status, prior US covered earnings, legal status, population stocks and every post-entry transition remain out of scope
residual_domains_entrants_do_enter: mortality (age/sex draw at the entry age)

alignment_summary.basis: the donor is reweighted, not resampled, so the residual against the control is floating-point arithmetic and not sampling noise

provenance.frame_coordinate: year = activation_year - 1, age = entry_age; the loop's first step is a mortality draw at the entry age, then aging advances to entry_age + 1 in the activation year (loop.py:236-239, 262-281; convention per m6_population.py:328-334)
provenance.id_allocation: projection-wide SyntheticPersonIdAllocator; loop.py:52-61 raises on any overlap with reserved_real_ids
provenance.method_detail: every donor row appears once per activation year with its weight scaled by a single factor, so the cohort's weighted total equals the control and its composition equals the donor exactly; no RNG is consumed and no row is resampled
provenance.sizing_basis_disclosure: a stock-accounting inflow proxy, NOT a count of physical arrivals: V.A2's temporary-or-unlawfully-present inflow counts only those who remain to year-end, so the gross total understates border arrivals and the cohort must not be read as one (2026 OASDI Trustees Report Table V.A2; the same qualification PR #218 section 0 states for this control)
sizing_excludes: outflow (the engine has no emigration law)
adjustment of status (a reclassification, not a new person)
total net change (a residual with no literal composition)
